messages.ui.title: Kiosk on the Nile
messages.ui.subtitle: A quiet spot, a good cup of tea, and stories by the Nile.
messages.ui.consume: Eat / drink what you are holding
messages.supply.basket: Basket — set quantity to zero to leave an item out
messages.supply.week_help: Days follow the game’s seven-day cycle, starting with day 1.
messages.supply.leave: You may leave the batch in this storage while I am away.
messages.supply.once: One extra order — arrives in {minutes} minutes
messages.supply.confirm_cash: Pay for the waiting cash delivery
messages.supply.offer_only: This is only an offer. No goods or money have moved. Accepting replaces future recurring terms.
messages.supply.done: Done. The details are recorded in your accounts.
messages.supply.storage_invalid: Choose storage that fits the whole basket and its storage requirements.
messages.supply.invalid_basket: Check the basket and available quantities.
messages.supply.insufficient: You do not have enough cash.
messages.supply.stale: This offer expired or its storage changed. Ask for a fresh offer.
messages.supply.contact: Stay on the call and near the phone.
messages.supply.nothing_due: There is nothing left to pay.
messages.supply.allowed: May be left while you are away
messages.supply.required: Your presence is required; no permission to leave goods.
messages.supply.none: No active recurring agreement. Your prepaid funds are retained.
messages.story.supplier.greeting: Hello, Fathi speaking. What can I do for you? Let’s work out what you need and when.
messages.story.supplier.manage_choice: Let’s go over my deliveries and account.
messages.story.supplier.manage_reply: We’ll check the goods, storage, timing and payment. Nothing is agreed until you are happy with the details.
messages.story.supplier.help_choice: I’m short on cash. Could you put something to eat on my account?
messages.story.supplier.offer: I can send you a liver sandwich for EGP {amount} on your account. No delivery charge for this. One at a time until the last one is paid for. Shall I send it?
messages.story.supplier.accept_choice: Yes, please. Send it over and put it on my account.
messages.story.supplier.accept_reply: There you go. You have the sandwich, and the price is in your notebook. Take your time and eat.
messages.story.supplier.decline_choice: Thanks, but I’ll leave it for now.
messages.story.supplier.decline_reply: No trouble. Nothing has gone on your account.
messages.story.supplier.reason.unpaid: There’s still a sandwich on your account. Settle that one first, then I can send another.
messages.story.supplier.reason.hands: Put down what you’re holding somewhere safe first, so you can take the sandwich.
messages.story.supplier.reason.stock: I’m out of ready sandwiches today. I can sort something out for you tomorrow.
messages.story.supplier.bye_choice: I’ll call again later, Uncle Fathi.
messages.story.supplier.bye_reply: Any time. Take care of yourself.
messages.supply.reason.storage_changed: The agreed storage moved or is no longer available.
messages.supply.reason.storage_full: There is no room for the whole batch.
messages.supply.reason.permission_required: No permission to leave goods while you are away.
messages.supply.reason.cash_presence_required: Cash delivery needs your presence and confirmation.
messages.supply.reason.prepaid_insufficient: There are not enough prepaid funds.
messages.supply.reason.credit_limit: This batch would exceed the agreed credit limit.
messages.supply.reason.stock_missing: The supplier cannot fill the whole basket today.
